summary: Afya Ltd filed a Form 6-K for the month of May 2026, announcing its first-quarter 2026 financial results. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, reporting revenue, adjusted EBITDA, net income, and operational highlights. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic report with no extraordinary corporate action.
